0022600097.text: The Toronto Raptors (1-0) visit the Washington Wizards (1-0), with Toronto 2nd in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back, and 4th in the East, while Washington is 2nd in the Southeast and 5th in the East. Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (heel, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot, fracture), and Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle, sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 134-125 win in Washington on February 28.
